decisions.reason: The topic-document obligation is already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY with topic_and_keyword_document_required set to true, so no addition or edit is needed.
Requesting a document containing the blog topic and keywords does not change internal-link inclusion, destinations, or publication timing.
The requested topic-and-keyword document does not alter blog publication approval or publication prerequisites.
The source message does not change image coverage, relevance, quantity, or the image-related publication condition.
The document-delivery request does not change the target audience for the AI dolls blog.
A separate document listing a blog topic and keywords does not change the required article type, inclusion in the trial, or article count.

The source specifically requests a document for the blog topic and its keywords; it does not modify the separate keyword research report, its keyword count, search-volume requirement, or replacement list.
The topic-and-keyword document is distinct from the SEO plan and does not change the plan's service-area coverage or exclusions.
